_readme: US-1997 AC4: the SHARED behavioural fixture for the category grading rubrics.
There are two rubric definitions — services/edge-functions/src/lib/rubric.ts (server
source of truth, carries prompt guidance + defect routing) and src/lib/rubrics.ts (client,
renders the certificate Factor Breakdown) — because the edge and the web app are separate
projects that cannot import each other. They are declared to stay in sync (factor keys +
weights + labels) and NOTHING pinned them, so a divergence would silently render a cert
against weights the grade was never computed on.
The guard is the SAME remedy US-1995 used for title-sync: both suites load this file and
assert their RUBRICS match it exactly. Change a rubric's factors/labels/weights HERE first,
then in both rubric modules — never in one module alone.
This file constrains ONLY key + label + weight (the fields both sides share). The server's
extra fields (guidance, promptGuidance, defectRouting) are not mirrored on the client and
are out of scope for the parity check.
